versions.changelog:
- Updated authentication guidance to prefer OAuth discovery over ingestion tokens for MCP connection.
- Clarified that write-only ingestion tokens are a fallback for environments without browser OAuth support.
- Improved setup instructions and privacy rules for safer user onboarding.
- Added guidelines for what to do when MCP is unavailable, prioritizing secure configuration steps.

- Initial release of perfly-agent-sync skill.
- Summarizes local coding work and sends user-approved worklog items to Perfly via the hosted Agent Sync MCP endpoint.
- Enforces strict privacy by only using metadata (e.g., branch names, commit titles, issue keys); never uploads source code, logs, or sensitive data.
- Provides a preview of work items before submission and requests user confirmation.
- Requires a Perfly MCP server configured with a write-only ingestion token.
- Includes clear payload and privacy rules to ensure safe, metadata-only reporting.
